tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The print-on-demand products Dripod can put a design on (T-shirts, hoodies, mugs, tumblers, hats, totes, phone cases, pillows, socks…), each with its blank colours and its page on drint.io. Narrow it by shelf or by a word in the name.

tools.name: pod_mockup
tools.description: Put a print-on-demand design on a product mockup in one blank colour and get a PNG. The design is the product's whole print area (a shirt's front, a mug's side, a case's back).
